gloss: exactly alike, the spitting image; entirely

definitions.explanation: Looking or being extremely similar to something or someone.
The whole thing without anything left out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧そっくり⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He looks just like his father.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧そっくり⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This painting looks exactly like the real thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{双子|ふたご}→双子：03599_futago⟧⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そっくり⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: They're twins, so their faces are exactly alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そっくり⟦{貯金|ちょきん}した→貯金：03497_chokin⟧。
⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そっくり⟦{盗|ぬす}まれた→盗む：01166_nusumu⟧。
examples.english: The entire contents of my wallet were stolen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そっくり⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}した→移す：10122_utsusu⟧。
examples.english: I moved the entire contents of the box exactly as they were to another box.

notes:
そっくり has two main uses:

1. RESEMBLANCE (extremely similar):
- A⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧そっくり⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: A looks just like B
- ⟦{瓜|うり}{二|ふた}つ→瓜二つ：19320_urifutatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧そっくり: like two peas in a pod
- ⟦そっくりさん→そっくりさん：noentry⟧: look-alike, doppelganger

2. ENTIRETY (all, completely):
- そっくり⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧: exactly as is
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そっくり⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to spend all the money
- そっくり⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧: to take everything

SIMILAR WORDS (for resemblance):
- ⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧: to resemble
- ⟦うり{二|ふた}つ→瓜二つ：19320_urifutatsu⟧: identical, like two peas in a pod
- ⟦そのもの→そのもの：noentry⟧: the very thing itself
